purpose: Reference results for Guard V1 on self-created synthetic fixtures (no dataset photos). Decisions are contract checks at the 0.75 threshold; p_sugarcane values are numeric goldens.
provenance: p_sugarcane goldens were generated on 2026-11-19 with the pinned binary through Pillow (EXIF transpose, bilinear resize to 224x224) and ai-edge-litert, restored unchanged from commit d17a5bc. test_guard_v1_model.py checks them through a SECOND, independent implementation (numpy-only EXIF orientation and half-pixel bilinear resize without antialiasing, the app's semantics) as well as the Pillow path.
